annotations.title: Get plan allowances and remaining credit

description:
Get plan allowances and remaining credit

Returns what the account still has available: its status, its prepaid wallet balance in EUR, the voice minutes and chat conversations left, and the subscribed plan with its monthly allowances. `plan` is null when the account is on no plan, in which case the remaining counters are whatever credit has been granted directly. Poll this before starting a batch of calls or a campaign to avoid running an account to zero mid-run. The answer is a bare object, not wrapped in a `data` envelope.
